source.description:
PROBLEM: Operator wants specialist event surfaces prettier and aligned with the fleet chrome, restrained: a magenta rail on the far left of specialist events (tool-result cards and fleet rows), consistent with the existing accent family.

SUCCESS: Specialist event text carries a far-left magenta rail (│-style gutter in the XTRM accent) with aligned keys/values; readable in both collapsed and expanded contexts; operator eyeball-confirms restrained (pretty, not noisy).

SCOPE: Specialists repo render builders only (renderResult summaries, fleet row/collapsed strings in index.mjs) + unit tests asserting rail presence and alignment. ANSI via existing theme helpers only.

NON_GOALS: Content/wording changes (other beads own rows, hint, purpose); layout/placement changes; inspector (deferred); any behavior change.

CONSTRAINTS: Restrained: one rail, alignment, no emoji, no extra chrome. Suite green, tsc clean. No src/dist changes.

VALIDATION: Unit tests (rail prefix on every rendered line, alignment); operator live eyeball in bead notes.

OUTPUT: Commit on a specialists branch, operator confirmation in notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes: Rail shipped on feature/unitAI-beqby.13-magenta-rail. RAIL=\x1b[35m│\x1b[0m (XTRM magenta, same family as src/cli/format-helpers magenta) via withRail() in config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs. Applied to renderCollapsedLine, renderFleetRowLine (both markers), section overflow line, and every humanResultOf render line incl. expanded JSON. Content/wording untouched. tests/unit/pi: 232 green; tsc clean. Awaiting operator live eyeball for restrained confirmation.
source.title: Magenta rail + restrained polish for specialist event cards
